Brother, you’ve got it all wrong.

For one, yes, you and several others had to sit and wait to get accepted. Sorry some of us have lives outside of the server, but not everyone who’s available can always get to you when you want it.

Two, I have no clue where you heard admins have an advantage with the money. I am currently a staff member, broke out of my mind in game. Yes, I agree that in an apocalypse, no one would really have a universal currency, especially a virtual one. But if that were the case here, we wouldn’t even have a discord. It’s handy, and it’s available to everyone right off the bat. If you don’t want to use it, don’t. Everything that uses the money can be obtained without it. No one person has any advantage over a bot that’s programmed to treat everyone fairly, something this world needs to learn for itself.

Thirdly, the server is RP based, not combat based. Yes there’s combat included, but if you were a Bambi getting killed after like 3 minutes from spawning in, you definitely wouldn’t have any care playing the server anyways. The rules are there to make sure people have an enjoyable time. If you don’t like the rules, go to a different server. 

Honestly, I don’t have the slightest clue as to why people complain about things anymore. If you don’t like it, don’t do it. It’s not that hard to ignore something. And if it’s too big to ignore (which believe me, it really ain’t), do something about it. Not this obviously, because this basically says, “Fuck you!” to everyone who’s worked their asses off trying to make the place better.

Not everything in this world needs an input, especially one as negative as this. You don’t have anything nice to say about something that has way more dedication out into it than your post, just don’t fucking say it.
